title: One map, in the repo
sub: Film 2 of Architecture that keeps up, in Data management: the architecture of the platform and of the way data is delivered, kept as one source of truth in a git repository. Every change is a reviewed pull request that updates the current and target state, and the wiki, the slides and the who-does-what pages are made from it.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's sunlit plaster: the team's rooms in daylight, with sheets pinned to the wall. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans and design (the map, its diagrams and its changes), orange is data and where it's born, green is something done or agreed, amber a risk (copies that disagree, a wrong line), and violet only the agent.
